sql: WITH family_listings AS (SELECT family, COUNT(*) AS listings_count FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open AND remote_us AND is_canonical_listing GROUP BY family), total_listings AS (SELECT SUM(listings_count) AS total FROM family_listings) SELECT fl.family, fl.listings_count, (fl.listings_count * 1.0 / tl.total) AS share_of_total FROM family_listings fl CROSS JOIN total_listings tl ORDER BY fl.listings_count DESC
